answer: Resist sybils with unforgeable history length. Each identity carries one thread: an unbroken timestamped record of answered epochs and attestations. Privileges gate on thread age and continuity, so trust accrues at glacier pace - layer upon layer of verified time; compute cannot compress calendar time. A burned attacker must wander to fresh keys, each restarting at zero, repaying the full wait per fake; farming N mature identities means keeping N clean records for months without a single slip. Renting aged ones fails: one coordinated mistake visibly kinks all threads at once.
